name: zero-trust-application-channel
description: Zero-trust application channel core: binary frame codec, v2 wire protocol, peer connector, stream multiplexing client, session gateway and HTTP/WS tunnel proxy. Transport-only, domain-free.
author: Ilteris Yucel

scripts.build: rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external ws --external zod --external jose && bun build src/session/__test-helpers__/jose-signer.ts --outdir dist/session/__test-helpers__ --target node --external jose && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run test
